english.title: Conspire to commit indictable / either way offence outside England and Wales in relation to public order and riot

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1, 1A and 3 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

date and location

english.notes:
(i) This offence should only be used where the conspiracy is to commit public order and riot offences OUTSIDE OF England and Wales.
(ii) Section 1A of the Criminal Law Act 1977, as amended by section 72 of the Coroners and Justice Act 2009, provides conditions in relation to this offence.
(iii) Section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977 provides the offence of conspiracy. The ingredients of the statutory offence of conspiracy were set out at length in R v Saik 2006.
(iv) MoPI Group 2 has been allocated to ensure manual review. The MoPI group of the substantive offence applies.

other.penalty:
Penalty is the same as for the relevant substantive offence.

If the relevant offence carries a fine only, then an unlimited fine may be imposed.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None
